title: fix: improvements to preview logic
body:
- use the focused preview thread row to manage show/hide of the preview and scrolling
- need to collapse preview rows because we style the area with more height and outlook thinks it should expand them all
- fix search results check
- rework height styling of the inbox/preview to make it work
- set bundled emails to 1px height so outlook doesn't lose the element
- add space for copilot message in the preview

commits.messageBody:
- use the focused preview thread row to manage show/hide of the preview and scrolling
- need to collapse preview rows because we style the area with more height and outlook thinks it should expand them all
- fix search results check
- rework height styling of the inbox/preview to make it work
- set bundled emails to 1px height so outlook doesn't lose the element
- add space for copilot message in the preview
- tweak z-index for preview to show

commits.messageHeadline: fix: repair inline preview for outlook's updated DOM
commits.messageBody:
- pin previewed row correctly: fix sticky scrollport (.zXLz3 overflow) and
  lift the list stacking wrapper (.rRhzD) above the preview pane
- clean up sticky classes and data-previewing when the preview closes
- scroll opened email below the pinned row (scroll-margin-top) instead of
  centering it behind the header; fall back to the placeholder target when
  the focused row is zero-size
- keep thread history collapsed via CSS instead of double-clicking every row;
  covers messages loaded by "see more messages"
- add native-list-fallback kill-switch if outlook floods the full-height list
- update bundle row markup for outlook's new list DOM

commits.messageHeadline: fix: run on outlook.cloud.microsoft and repair selectors for the upda…
commits.messageBody:
…ted DOM

Outlook now redirects to outlook.cloud.microsoft. The content script's
module import was refused there because the domain was missing from
web_accessible_resources, so only the CSS ran.

- add the new domain to content script matches and web_accessible_resources
- update hashed classes that changed: subject, participants, preview
  background, date column, hover actions, preview scroll wrapper,
  multi-select buttons; drop constants for elements outlook no longer renders
- selection is now a single class on the outer row container; follow that in
  setSelectedRow and the bundle expand/collapse handlers
- rebuild the bundle row markup to mirror the current row structure and give
  it outlook's row-background class so it paints like a native row
- stable selectors for time group headers (id prefix) and the compose "To"
  row (aria-label); fall back to the folder pane for the account email now
  that the brand link is gone; detect "nothing selected" via the conversation
  container instead of a removed placeholder class
- keyboard scroll shortcuts target the list scroll container; pinned email
  offset follows the new 37px row height

commits.messageHeadline: fix: clear stale bundle-last-email markers and tolerate an invalidate…
commits.messageBody:
…d extension context

- inbox: outlook appends new mail at the end of the dom and reorders it later,
  so a row that was briefly last kept its bundle-last-email class and its 12px
  spacing; clear the class from every other row of the label instead of only
  the first match
- options: after the extension is reloaded, content scripts still running in
  open tabs lose their chrome.* apis and every option read rejected with
  "Extension context invalidated"; check the context first, catch storage
  errors, and keep the last known options
